Using your United Airlines miles can be a great way to redeem for a business class ticket.

According to United's award chart, a one-way business class ticket from Chicago (ORD) to London (LHR) requires:

* 60,000 MileagePlus miles during off-peak dates (typically November to March)
* 70,000 MileagePlus miles during peak dates (typically April to October, which includes your desired travel period in July or August)

Please note that these rates are subject to change, and United may adjust their award chart at any time.

Additionally, you'll need to consider the following:

* Taxes and fees: You'll need to pay these in addition to the miles, and they can range from $100 to $200 or more, depending on the route and travel dates.
* Availability: Award availability can be limited, especially during peak travel seasons. You may need to be flexible with your travel dates or consider alternative routes.
* Booking fees: United may charge a booking fee for award tickets, which can range from $25 to $50 per ticket.

Before redeeming your miles, I recommend checking the award availability on United's website or through their customer service. You can also consider using a tool like ExpertFlyer or AwardAvailability to search for available seats.

If you have any questions or need help with the booking process, feel free to ask!
